meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑一次视觉核对,用截图确认界面改动是否正常。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完界面都要靠肉眼反复确认有没有走样。
copy.tagline_en: Check any UI change with screenshots and get a clear pass-or-fail verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep eyeballing every UI change to make sure nothing broke.

howto.what: 对渲染出来的界面做视觉 QA:先截图取证、跑脚本得到 diff 比例和溢出行等数字,再派两个只读评审子代理并行审查,最后合成一个通过/退回/失败的判定。
howto.when: 在构建或改动 UI 之后、宣布完成之前触发;当输出要匹配 mock、基线或设计意图,或怀疑有回归、CJK 文本截断、终端布局溢出时。

say.text: 给这个页面跑一次 visual QA,给我判定和截图证据
say.note: 先截图跑 image-diff,再派两个评审

say.text: 拿这份 Figma 参考图对比现在的实现,逐页截图
say.note: 每个参考页面和视口都要对比

say.text: 这个 TUI 在 120 列下会溢出吗?跑一下 tui-check
say.note: 返回最大宽度和溢出行的 JSON

howto.what_en: Does visual QA on a rendered UI: captures screenshots and script evidence (diff ratio, overflow lines), dispatches two read-only reviewers in parallel, then returns one PASS/REVISE/FAIL verdict.
howto.when_en: Runs after any UI build or change, before calling it done; when output must match a mock, baseline, or stated intent, or you suspect a regression, CJK clipping, or terminal overflow.

say_en.text: Run visual QA on this page and give me a verdict with screenshot evidence
Compare the current build against this Figma reference, page by page
say_en.note: every reference page and viewport is compared

say_en.text: Will this TUI overflow at 120 columns? Run tui-check
say_en.note: returns max width and overflow lines
